The participation of tribal women in the political process, especially in North Bengal has
grown manifolds. This has much to do with reservation of seats for tribal women, right
from the panchayats to Lok Sabha elections. Under these conditions the political parties
are legitimaly bound to appoint tribal women as their candidate for elections ranging from
the basic panchayat levels up to election of highest echelons of power that is the Lok
Sabha. During the course of my numerous interactions with tribal women who have been
